dslRule:
<!id: integer.parseint.optimization>
<!description: Replace Integer.valueOf($arg) with Integer.parseInt($arg) to avoid unnecessary wrapper object creation when a primitive int is expected (available since Java 1.0, baseline Java 8).
>
<!severity: HINT>
java.lang.Integer.valueOf($arg)
=> java.lang.Integer.parseInt($arg)
;;
